text:
Zara: Quick thought 12:15 Thursday mini-golf + milkshake run? 9 holes, should be ~40 mins. :put_litter_in_its_place:
Milo: love this. which course?
Zara: Putter Palace, 5 mins from office. cheap and gets us back by 1pm.
Bea: count me in if there's a veggie option at the shake place (no bacon bits pls).
Connor: i'm in. any shoe rules? I only have clogs.
Tomo: clogs might be fine but avoid heels. they have rental putters and balls.
Priya: can someone check if Putter Palace takes cards? small cash only would be annoying.
Zara: they take cards but $1 minimum, so pool cash if lots of small orders.
lunchbot: Poll posted: "Mini-golf + milkshakes Thu 12:15 - coming?" React :thumbsup: to join, :thumbsdown: to skip. I'll DM attendees at 11:45.
Milo: :thumbsup:
Bea: :thumbsup:
Connor: :thumbsup:
Tomo: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Zara: expected group size 6-8. if anyone needs to duck early, no worries.
Bea: can we do a quick prize? winner gets the 'golden straw' (a silly trophy I have).
Connor: stakes accepted. i'll practice my windmill putt. :golf:
Milo: accessibility note - course has a ramp but surfaces are a bit uneven for wheelchairs. sharing so folks can decide.
Zara: thanks for the note. backup option (= indoor cafe) if it's pouring.
Tomo: i'll bring a small portable speaker and a 6-pack of napkins.
Priya: i'll handle milkshake orders if someone sends me preferences by 11:30.
Milo: vote on flavors? :chocolate: chocolate, :strawberry: strawberry, :vanilla: vanilla. react to pick.
Bea: :strawberry:
Connor: :chocolate:
Tomo: :vanilla:
Zara: final: Putter Palace Thu 12:15, milkshakes after, BYO snack if you want. Zara: i'll post a reminder at 11:50 and leave a sign at the lobby. :bell:
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Mini-golf + milkshakes" Thu 11:45 - pinging attendees 30m before."
